title: docs(skills): drop the removed feature_flags settings manifest from plugin-development
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DGkdjxdHsKhS4HATauzmjF1)_
Fixes #30275
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`objectstack-platform` 技能包的插件开发参考页里,删掉「`feature_flags` 设置清单(`ai_enabled` / `beta_*`、`OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_*`)」这条,改成现行答案:插件需要组织级开关时,自己声明一份设置清单并注册到 `settings` 服务。
- **为什么改**:该命名空间已从设置服务移除,读它会被拒、那些环境变量不起作用;客户的 AI 照旧文档写代码或指导管理员会做无用功。
- **风险与回滚**:只改一条文档与一个 changeset,运行时零改动;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:① `skills/objectstack-platform/references/plugin-development.md` 的「Feature Flags」节第一条;② `.changeset/30275-plugin-dev-feature-flags-bullet.md`。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs | grep plugin-development`,预期 3125 tokens(上限 3137),且 `git grep -n feature_flags -- skills/` 无输出。
- **需要你做的**:批准合并(`skills/**` 属 Tier H,需人合)。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-platform/references/plugin-development.md`, section "Feature Flags": the bullet teaching a `feature_flags` settings manifest (`ai_enabled` / `beta_*` toggles, env overrides via `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_*`) is replaced by the live answer: there is no shared flags namespace; a plugin that needs an org toggle declares its own `SettingsManifest` and registers it on the `settings` service (ADR-0007 cascade). The next bullet (`PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES`, the deployment-level capability flags) is unchanged.
- `.changeset/30275-plugin-dev-feature-flags-bullet.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, with both declaration lines.

## Why

PR #30272 (#30204) removed the `feature_flags` namespace from `@objectstack/service-settings`. On `origin/main` `badf24df`, `builtinSettingsManifests` no longer lists it, and `settings-service.test.ts` pins `getManifest('feature_flags')` to `SETTINGS_UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE` with `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_AI_ENABLED` set and inert. A customer agent reading the old bullet would write checks against a namespace that is refused, or tell an administrator to set an env var that does nothing.

The replacement is read off `main` code: `SettingsManifest` is re-exported from `@objectstack/service-settings` "so plugin authors only need one import" (`src/index.ts`), `SettingsServicePlugin` registers its service under `'settings'` (`settings-service-plugin.ts`), and `SettingsService.registerManifest(manifest)` is a public method (`settings-service.ts`).

## Tests

Docs-only change in the published skills bundle; no code or test changed.

Size readings (`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, both on this tree):

- `references/plugin-development.md`: 359 → 358 lines, 3137 → 3125 tokens (ceiling 3137, unchanged).
- Package `objectstack-platform`, all SKILL.md: unchanged (no SKILL.md touched).
- Whole shipped bundle: 226234 → 226222 tokens.

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance 2: `git grep -n -i 'feature_flags\|OS_FEATURE_FLAGS'` over `skills/**` on `origin/main` `badf24df` hits only the three lines of this bullet. No eval of any package prompts for them, so no eval is edited (and `evals/config-plugins-ops.json`, held by PR #30704, is untouched).
- Acceptance 3: PR #30272 is merged; this text matches `main`.

## Verification

Local gates on head `997decb3` (after merging `origin/main`): the 43 families `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives from this diff, plus `pnpm lint` (exit 0). `--ran` reconciliation: 43 derived, 41 run green, 2 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun.

NOT MEASURED (declared narrowing): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` exit 3 (prerequisite: built `dist/` for every package). They judge build output, which a Markdown edit and a changeset cannot move; no whole-tree build was run for an S docs card, and CI runs them on a built tree.
